title: Reed Colonnade
description: A short upward question passes through a seven-bar dialogue. Neither hand keeps a regular accompaniment: one continues while the other pauses, and their phrases briefly overlap. A more animated C-major exchange leads to a shared answer whose bass is changed on its final return.
technical_note: Carry the three-beat pulse through rests without turning it into a waltz accompaniment. Allow tied upper notes to outlast the lower replies. The closing sixths should sound like two voices agreeing, not an accented chord sequence.

performance.note: Authored breathing, changing dialogue and independent voicing; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
